Maya (CSM): Quick flag 4d NovusData renewal in 18 days. Usage dropped sharply this month; they
re only hitting health-check pings. No batch runs.
Ravi (Onboarding): Do we have any recent support tickets or integration PRs?
Maya (CSM): Nothing in tickets since last month. Two faint commits to their integration repo mid-month, then silence.
Priya (PS): Could be stuck on auth or chunking. Ill run a short diagnostic: token distribution, error traces, and job scheduling.
Liam (AE): We should avoid surprises at renewal. If they're blocked, a focused "unblock" package might help: 45m tech session + run credits.
ops-bot: ALERT: account "NovusData" flagged: usage_drop>50% over 30d; renewal_due_in=18d; suggested_action=engage_immediately.
Maya (CSM): Proposed micro-play: 1) 45m integration lab with Ravi/Priya 2) 10-point runbook for their infra team 3) conditional 2-week compute credit if they re-run ingestion.
Ravi (Onboarding): I can lead the lab Wed or Fri. Will prepare a troubleshooting checklist covering auth, chunking, KV cache warmup, and model variant compatibility.
Priya (PS): I'll prepare an "impact brief" slide showing expected throughput at their current profile vs optimized config; also include common causes for silent dropoffs.
Liam (AE): I'll draft the commercial fallback: 2-week credit terms and a short downgrade path if we don't see re-engagement. Need to keep terms simple.
Maya (CSM): Excellent. Also want a success metric: +25% weekly tokens within 14 days post-lab, otherwise escalate to AE for incentives.
NovusData - Tara: Thanks for the heads-up. Weve been trying to stabilize on our sidehad a provider token mismatch last week. Can we do the lab? Prefer Fri morning.
Maya (CSM): Fri 9am PT works. Ravi + Priya confirmed.
Priya (PS): Quick ask: Tara, can you bring the infra lead and one dev who wrote the ingestion script? That will let us triage faster.
NovusData - Tara: Yep, inviting both.
Ravi (Onboarding): I found two failed job logs tied to tokenization errors; sending snippet:
```
ERROR JobRunner: decode_failed at chunk 34 - invalid token sequence
Traceback: TokenizerError: index out of range
```
Ravi (Onboarding): Looks like an encoding mismatch between their client and our tokenizer.
Maya (CSM): Good find. That maps to the spike in failed runs on 04/03. Priya, this aligns with the optimization notes you planned.
Priya (PS): Will surface that in the impact brief and include a small config diff they can apply during the lab.
Liam (AE): Commercial note: I'll offer the 2-week credit if they commit to the lab and a follow-up QBR in 14 days. If no uptake, I'll propose a downgraded seat + data retention change with 30d notice.
Maya (CSM): Let's also capture feedback during the lab: what docs were missing, what SDK behaviors confused them, any blockers for scale. We want operational signals for product.
Priya (PS): I'll make a single-page "post-lab feedback" form we can send immediately.
ops-bot: NOTE: last save-play for NovusData 90d ago. Outcome=partial. Recommend hands-on session as top priority.
Maya (CSM): Action items: Ravi (lead lab Fri 9am PT), Priya (impact brief + feedback form), Liam (credit & downgrade terms), Maya (outreach + QBR scheduling).
Ravi (Onboarding): Calendar invite sent to NovusData + internal leads. Will attach checklist and a tiny pre-lab runbook.
Priya (PS): Uploading impact brief now: https://redwood.internal/cs/novus-impact-brief
Liam (AE): Commercial template ready; will tailor after lab outcomes.
Maya (CSM): Thank you. Expect a follow-up in this thread after the lab with recording, findings, and the agreement on the credit or downgrade path.
NovusData - Tara: Appreciated. See you Fri.
Maya (CSM): Closing loop: owner Maya, priority=high. Next update after lab (last_message_ts updated). :handshake:
